把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上，主干就露出来了。: Fold each modifier onto the word it modifies, and the skeleton shows.
主语、谓语和宾语。: The subject, the verb and the object.
标出这句话的主干。: Mark the skeleton of this sentence.
主语、谓语、宾语就是整句的主干。: Subject, verb and object are the whole skeleton.
主干 = 谁 + 做什么 + 对什么。: Skeleton = who + does what + to what.
标出主语、谓语和宾语。: Mark the subject, the verb and the object.
介词短语也可以挂在动词上。: A prepositional phrase can also hang on the verb.
We train the model on one GPU.
<i>on one GPU</i> 说明的是训练这件事。: on one GPU tells about the training.
说明“在哪、怎么做”挂动词。: Where or how: on the verb.
标出主干，把修饰成分挂到它修饰的词上。: Mark the skeleton and fold the modifier onto the word it modifies.
句子说的是谁、是什么。标出它的名词短语：修饰成分都折起来以后，剩下的那几个词。: Who or what the sentence is about. Mark its noun phrase: the words left once its modifiers are folded.
主语做什么、怎么样：整个动词词组，连同助动词（has been shown）。: What the subject does or is: the whole verb group, auxiliaries included (has been shown).
动作落到的东西，跟在谓语后面的名词短语。: What the action lands on: the noun phrase after the verb.
介词开头的一串词（of the model、on a single GPU），整: A preposition and what follows it (of the model, on a single GPU), modifying one word as a whole. Fold it and hang it on that word.
